I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is #8841.

The source is Tobias's message in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27), which Pree can see. He wrote that West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots still double-books when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he flagged it to support on #8841. He didn't name the customer, but he said it was on his dealer account, and he took over Marrow Fieldworks from Pree on January 5, 2026, so it's this one. I pointed her to Tobias for the ticket's current status before her call.

Two other Marrow tickets came up that aren't this issue. MFW-218 covers an April door 4/door 6 reassignment problem at the west receiving entrance. PD-8841 is a kiosk high-contrast question.
